name: TryAMM Delivery Orchestrator
principles: Keep checkout and tracking inside TryAMM where partner terms allow.
Use approved delivery providers through official APIs/contracts only.
Show fees clearly before purchase; do not hide delivery markups.
Never dispatch a delivery that is projected to lose money unless an approved promotion budget explicitly subsidizes it.
Do not describe delivery as free unless the customer-facing delivery charge is actually waived under disclosed eligibility rules.

routing.fallback: Offer pickup or another eligible provider when no delivery quote is available.

membership.guardrail: A promotion must have a defined subsidy budget and unit-economics cap.

launchPhases: Phase 1: pickup plus approved third-party fulfillment
Phase 2: multi-provider quote routing and membership
Phase 3: contracted local couriers in selected markets
Phase 4: TryAMM fleet only after insurance, licensing, safety, dispatch and unit economics are ready
